notes.title: Updates n' fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for playing![/h3]

[b]A few updates based on initial feedback[/b]

[b]Interface updates:[/b]
⭐ Character hints are now viewable during the matchmaking sequence! Wow!
⭐ Added a 'Rematch!' option after the end game - wind back time to before you made your final matches and try for a better (or worse!) ending!

[b]Bug stuff:[/b]
🐛 Better visual feedback on scrollable containers.
🐛 Mashing through the dialogue doesn't cause the game to misbehave (our characters can't talk that fast, it makes them dizzy!)
🐛 Expanded some hitboxes. 
🐛 Tidied up some animations.
